description: Return the public course page at https://agenticdesign.school/courses/<slug>, where the buyer completes the purchase. This tool does not create a checkout session, does not create a Stripe customer, and does not look up an account. An optional email is ignored. The response for a slug does not change with other arguments. Prices are US dollars and include GST for Australian customers. Purchases are one-time. Fundamentals is free with an account. The three leadership courses are US$300 once, sold together.

email.description: Ignored. The buyer completes the purchase on the course page.

slug.description: Course slug from list_courses, such as claude-code-for-designers.
